title: A joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities says "we have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct" (Lean community blog)
summary: Lean community blog: A joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities says “we have full confidence that Alpöge's proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is correct” — Joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities, endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib Initiative.
